title: ProjectState
description: STATE-01 raw project-state contract. The daemon normalizes bridge snapshots into this shape; every RawState the daemon holds is valid against this schema. Source: docs/seed.md §A 'Raw project state' generalized into JSON Schema 2020-12 (RESEARCH.md §Code Examples 'raw-state schema seed').
$comment: Phase 2 freezes the raw-state contract Plans 03/04/05 implement against. TRUST-SPINE: selection.trackSid/clipSid/deviceSid carry the ^trk_/^clip_/^dev_ fingerprint pattern (STATE-04) — a bare Bitwig slot index like 'trk_5' is structurally invalid (Pitfall 2 defense, RESEARCH.md lines 800-805). stateFreshness is optional HERE (the raw-state can be persisted without it) but REQUIRED on every cli-query result (result.schema.json) so SC#3 staleness surfaces to every CLI consumer. automation is reserved EMPTY in M1 (maxItems 0 — D-04: automation mirror deferred). additionalProperties:false at EVERY object level (PATTERNS.md Assignment 1). Phase 5 (05-01) adds the daemon-side observation extensions: parameters = BOUNDED per-parameter movement aggregates folded from parameter.changed events (AUTO-01/D-05-01 — maxProperties 512 mirrors the fold's eviction cap; aggregates only, NEVER an event log, T-05-03) and project.transport.automationWrite = the D-05-05 write-state vocabulary folded from transport.changed. Neither field is bridge-emitted — snapshots without them stay valid.

version.description: Schema contract version (major.minor). Drives version-drift detection.

stateFreshness.description: SC#3 staleness marker. Optional on the persisted raw-state; REQUIRED on cli-query results. 'live' = bridge recently observed; 'stale' = bridge silent past watchdog threshold; 'disconnected' = bridge gone.

automationWrite.description: Automation-write state folded verbatim from transport.changed payloads (Phase 5, D-05-05) — the refusal-gate vocabulary for the automation apply path (05-05+).

overrideActive.description: An automation override is currently active.

selection.description: The GUI selection (cursor triple). All fields optional — selection can be empty (deselection). *Sid fields are STATE-04 fingerprint IDs, NOT Bitwig slot indices (Pitfall 2).

trackSid.description: STATE-04 fingerprint of the selected track. NEVER a bare slot index.

clipSid.description: STATE-04 fingerprint of the pinned/selected clip.

deviceSid.description: STATE-04 fingerprint of the selected device.

tracks.description: Windowed TrackBank[N=8] snapshot (D-01). Open objects — element shape tightened when STATE-04 fingerprint map lands.

clips.description: Pull-result cache (bw-midi inspect NoteStep dump). Open objects — element shape tightened in Phase 3.

devices.description: Pull-result cache (bw-device inspect CursorRemoteControlsPage walk, incl. VST/AU per D-02). Open objects — element shape tightened in Phase 5.

automation.description: D-04: automation mirror is deferred to Phase 5 (AUTO-01). The slot is RESERVED EMPTY in M1 — maxItems 0 enforces this at the schema level so producers cannot leak automation data prematurely.

parameters.description: Phase 5 (AUTO-01/D-05-01): bounded per-parameter MOVEMENT AGGREGATES keyed by `${deviceKey}:${source}:${paramIndex}`, folded daemon-side from parameter.changed events. NEVER an event log — each entry is 8 bounded scalar fields (T-05-03) and the map is capped at 512 entries (the fold evicts the lowest-lastMovedAt entry; maxProperties mirrors the cap for defense in depth).

deviceKey.description: Device identity key in the selected track's chain.

paramIndex.description: Parameter index within the device (cursorDevice.getParameter(int) window).

movementCount.description: Movements observed (incoming value differing from lastValue by more than 1e-4).

lastMovedAt.description: Unix-seconds timestamp of the last movement (drives lowest-lastMovedAt eviction).
